_note: Hacking (docs/HACKING.md). Targets: the fixed specials in os.json plus places generated from the town (kinds below). One hack = CONNECT (route the signal, PATCHBAY) then INJECT (code chain: spell program codes). On site (air gap): TUNE (match the signal) then INJECT against a patrol clock. Text here is placeholder flavour; the user may rewrite any of it. Numbers are first guesses: tune here.

wipe.name: WIPE
wipe.text: Wipe the logs: trace down by a third.

dirt.name: DIRT
dirt.text: Dig through the owner's mail: dirt on them, and their password for next time.

camera.name: EYES
camera.text: Link the building's cameras: you'll see them in a raid there.

redirect.name: REROUTE
redirect.text: Redirect a delivery: a crate waits at a drop tomorrow morning.

payroll.name: PAYDAY
payroll.text: Skim the payroll: money now, more heat.

knowledge_note: Programs without known:true are locked until learned (state.os.know). How you learn them is decided later (user 2026-11-22: build it all first). Debug: F1 panel or Hack.learn_all().

files: The books don't add up. Someone skims the difference.
Names and flats, street by street.
Next week's inspections, block by block.
Which trucks carry what, and when.
Company fuel cards and their limits.
What's coming in, and when the van comes.
Who bought what. Some of it is interesting.
Patient lists. Some names are Bureau.
Drugs signed out that never reached a patient.
Who's on, who's off, who sleeps at the desk.
What's in the armoury, and who holds the keys.
Names the precinct pays. Dangerous to hold.
